_note: Fixed test set for evaluation (evaluation/eval_plan.md §0). Chosen BEFORE looking at results. 'dev' topics may be used to tune prompts and thresholds; 'test' topics are held out: run them once with the frozen settings, annotate, and report - do not tune on them. Each topic is run once by evaluation/run_test_set.py; every annotator works from that saved run, so everyone judges the same papers.
